truth_boundary: This registry records currently created repositories and designed module roles. It does not prove operational integrations, live data connections, validated benefits, digital twins, autonomy or deployment unless a separate evidence receipt supports the exact claim.

modules.purpose_kernel: Show current truth, evidence, benefit, blockers and human-controlled next actions across the APEX portfolio.
modules.first_proof_target: MIRROR-PROTOTYPE-001 — interactive truth-labelled control-plane prototype using registered fixture data
modules.next_gate: Build and test a public-safe interactive prototype powered only by truth-labelled fixture/ledger records.
limitations: No live dashboard is proven from visual architecture alone.
No module health percentages are currently measured.

modules.purpose_kernel: Preserve claim, evidence, validation, promotion and provenance records so no module status outruns proof.
modules.first_proof_target: LEDGER-BUILD-001 — validate this registry and one evidence receipt using an automated test workflow
modules.next_gate: Add validated example evidence receipt and CI schema validation.
limitations: Schemas and records do not by themselves establish live operational validation.

modules.purpose_kernel: Progress bounded, approved, evidence-gated work beneath the Mirror without removing human authority.
modules.first_proof_target: AUTOMATER-PILOT-001 — execute one bounded public-safe documentation/test task from an approved work order
modules.next_gate: Define work-order, stop-rule, evidence-output and human-approval contracts.
limitations: No autonomous execution authority is established.
Proxy convergence is not real-world outcome proof.

modules.purpose_kernel: Define and bridge operational software through a simpler inspectable representation and validated target adapters.
modules.role: Bridging code and application generation module
modules.first_proof_target: OCODE-PILOT-001 — Analytics Mirror HTML/JS to OCODE to web.singlefile round-trip comparison
modules.next_gate: Implement and test a bounded OCODE-to-Web renderer and round-trip evidence packet.
limitations: Universal semantic source-to-target translation is not implemented.
Run-anywhere portability is aspirational until adapter tests pass.

modules.purpose_kernel: Improve capability through targets, baselines, practice, transfer tests, governance and evidence-bearing evolution.
modules.role: Learning and human-AI capability proof laboratory
modules.first_proof_target: PILOT-001 — bounded Human-only vs AI-only vs Human+AI learning comparison
modules.next_gate: Commit a public-safe pilot specification with measurable outcomes and governance controls.
limitations: Learning digital twin capability is not calibrated or validated.
Visual learning architecture is not measured learner evidence.

modules.purpose_kernel: Create a Centralized Analytics Program command center for dashboards, governance, KPI definitions, requests, learning and oversight.
modules.role: Business-facing analytics and data governance application
modules.first_proof_target: ANM-BUILD-002 — graph-rich selectable-layout 11D modeling-depth prototype with evidence labels
modules.next_gate: Seed implementation specification and test prototype interactions against declared gates.
limitations: The interactive mockup is not deployed to SharePoint.
Displayed program data must remain demo-labelled until real approved sources are connected.

modules.purpose_kernel: Analyze truth, gaps, waste, options, benefit and next-best governed direction for any active module.
modules.first_proof_target: ANA-PILOT-001 — analyze the Analytics Mirror prototype using defined truth and payoff criteria
modules.next_gate: Define analysis packet schema and run one bounded comparative review.
limitations: No executable analysis engine or validated scoring model yet exists.

modules.purpose_kernel: Convert bounded questions into cited, evidence-graded research packets that inform requirements and tests.
modules.first_proof_target: RES-PILOT-001 — evidence-graded adaptive learning methods packet for Learning Center design
modules.next_gate: Define research packet schema and complete one source-cited bounded research output.
limitations: Concept visual status indicators are not proof of active research streams.

modules.purpose_kernel: Provide a consistent system-modeling vocabulary from observation through governance, prediction and unified-model vision.
modules.first_proof_target: DIM-PILOT-001 — map the Analytics Mirror module through applicable modeling-depth layers
modules.next_gate: Create ontology registry and one public-safe module mapping.
limitations: Dimensions are a system-modeling/maturity framework, not a validated claim of physical higher-dimensional operation.

modules.purpose_kernel: Challenge module artifacts against acceptance gates, expose failures and prevent unsupported promotion.
modules.first_proof_target: TST-PILOT-001 — test Analytics Mirror prototype interaction and truth-labelling gates
modules.next_gate: Define test-result schema and run one deterministic public-safe validation packet.
limitations: No reusable executable cross-module test runner is currently proven.
